# Purpose

This R Markdown document describes the technical-analysis project structure and the role of the supporting R scripts.

## Inputs

The documented source script uses a small synthetic numeric vector so that the Markdown/R Markdown workflow can be reproduced without external data.

## Outputs

The workflow produces stock data frames, descriptive statistics, and technical-analysis results that can be inspected or visualized.

## Example Code

```{r}
source("analysis.R")
analysis_summary
```

## Quality Checks

The source script checks the synthetic data through summary statistics. Later project stages add portfolio and market-data validation.

## Conclusion

Using R Markdown provides a reproducible explanation of the code rather than leaving the script undocumented. This structure also makes the project easier to review and maintain in GitHub.
